thread:
sasha: quick question — should deps-only / lockfile churn cause a minor bump? we've been publishing 1.x -> 1.(y+1) for CI/tooling bumps and it's noisy.
omar: strong preference for deps-only -> patch. We want to avoid user-facing semver noise. Only bump minor for public API changes.
jia: agree. one nuance: if it touches our runtime deps (inference runtime) that could affect perf/latency semantics even if API unchanged — maybe treat those as minor?
mike: i worry about the rollout surface. ops expects minor bumps for anything that merits extra smoke tests. we should codify criteria instead of ad-hoc calls.
katie: proposal: enforce rules in release-bot. heuristics:
  - lockfile/package-lock changes only -> patch
  - devDependencies only -> patch
  - changes in packages/* that modify exported types or stable behavior -> minor
  - changelog entry required for minor
sasha: sounds good. can release-bot auto-detect devDeps vs deps vs code touches? deploy-bot already looks at BUILD files for deploy windows.
release-bot: automated rule check results:
  - diff files: package.json (packages/serve/package.json), yarn.lock
  - detected changes: devDependencies: jest 27 -> 28
  - change type suggestion: patch
  - action: label "release:patch-suggested"
  - note: no tests changed in packages/serve/src
  - link: https://ci.internal/release/1912345678/checks
mike: ok but what about pinning policy? if we pin to caret vs exact in monorepo, we get different churn. recommend: keep ^ for deps except for critical runtime libs where we pin to exact and require manual minor bump when upgrading.
jia: we should also add an escape hatch: if ops wants extra canary testing we can elevate a patch -> minor for a single deploy with a note.
sasha: agreed. request: add a PR template checkbox that says "deps-only (patch)" or "requires minor bump". that helps reviewers.
katie: i'll add the template and update release-bot rules. plan:
  - release-bot will read PR labels + diff to suggest bump (patch/minor)
  - if suggested minor != actual bump, block merge and require owner override with justification
  - allow a one-time override by "release-manager" team members
deploy-bot: FYI — if bump is minor and target branch is main, automatic canary windows: 30m -> full. patch bumps skip canary unless opt-in.
sasha: perfect. also let's log this policy in the release playbook and add a small section to the all-hands next week.
omar: +1. can we add an opt-in for autoskipping patch CI slices to speed things up? patch should run a subset of tests.
katie: will propose CI matrices: patch -> fast tests + lint, minor -> full matrix.
sasha: thanks team. next steps: katie implements release-bot changes, i will update PR template, and jia/mike please review pin list for runtime libs.
release-bot: action queued: apply label "release:patch-suggested" on PR #7821. If owner marks "force-minor" label, a reviewer override is required.
